First Yoruba pass. 20 -> 52 records. THE INVERSION AGAIN: Oshosi, the hunter orisha, was in the registry only as santeria_ochosi -- the diaspora form present and the Yoruba original absent, which is the third instance of this pattern in the programme after Nanaya/sogdian_nana and Lotan/yahwism_leviathan, and is flagged as a class of defect rather than three coincidences. Households were missing members: Oba (senior wife of Shango) in a registry holding Shango, Oya and Oshun; Yemowo in a registry holding Obatala; Aje in a registry holding her parent Olokun. THE OYO LINE: the registry held Shango, Aganju and Ajaka and then nothing -- no Orompoto (first female Alaafin, expelled the Nupe in 1555, founded the cavalry), no Ojigi (brought Dahomey to tribute in 1730), none of the eight eighteenth-century Alaafins destroyed by their own council, no Bashorun Gaa who destroyed four of them, no Abiodun, Aole, Afonja, Oluewu or Atiba, and no Moremi in a registry holding her husband Oranmiyan. 19 of the 32 additions are people rather than gods, and together they make the Oyo constitutional crisis expressible for the first time: the Oyo Mesi's parrot's egg, the Are Ona Kakanfo created by Ajagbo as its counterweight, and both instruments destroying what they were built to protect. 32 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/yoruba-expansion.txt. First Maya pass. 26 -> 90 records. A 79-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 9 hits and 70 absences, and several of the 9 are alias matches rather than holdings (Kisin resolves to maya_ah_puch, Ah Mun to maya_yum_kaax, Chac Chel to maya_ix_chel, God D to maya_itzamna). TWO DISTINCT GAPS. POPOL VUH: the corpus held the principals and almost nobody else in the book -- absent were Hun Batz and Hun Chouen, the elder half-brothers turned into monkeys who are the patron gods of every Maya scribe; their mother Xbaquiyalo; NINE OF THE TWELVE LORDS OF XIBALBA (it held the two supreme lords and exactly one of the ten subordinates, so the paired disease-offices were invisible); Avilix and Hacavitz, without whom Tohil is one god rather than the three that constitute the K'iche' lineage settlement; ALL FOUR of the men made of maize and ALL FOUR of their wives, who are what the book exists to explain; Xulu and Pacam, the seers through whom the Hero Twins arrange their own resurrection; and three of the four destroyers of the wooden people. CLASSIC PERIOD: not one Maya ruler was in the registry -- zero, in a corpus carrying Egyptian pharaohs, Mesopotamian kings, ten Mixtec lords and the whole Mexica tlatoani line. Nor were the gods the Classic inscriptions name: K'awiil (absent from a corpus about to hold SIX kings named after him -- the Ninurta/Ashur pattern again), God L, Pauahtun and the four Bacabs, GI and GIII of the Palenque Triad, Xaman Ek, Buluc Chabtan. 64 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/maya-expansion.txt: 27 Popol Vuh, 11 Classic gods, 23 rulers from six cities, 3 postclassic and colonial. ZERO pre-existing records mutated. The 23 rulers were chosen so the politics reads rather than samples: Tikal against Calakmul with both sides present (the 378 entrada, Stela 31, the Kaanul hegemony under Yuknoom the Great, Jasaw's reversal in 695); Palenque, where a succession through a woman produced the Cross Group theology; Copan and Quirigua, where in 738 a client beheaded the overlord who had installed him; Yaxchilan's Lintels 24 and 25; and El Peru-Waka', where Lady K'abel held kaloomte' and her husband did not. Three of the 23 are women who ruled or outranked. TRADITION-KEY PROBLEM, OBSERVED AND NOT TOUCHED: ALL TWELVE K'iche' records duplicate Maya records of the same Popol Vuh figures, and SEVEN of the twelve Yucatec Maya records duplicate Maya records -- nineteen figures held twice across three keys. Flagged as 11 CROSS-TRADITION rows, not merged; this is the third tradition in the programme needing that note (after Danel/Paghat and Olokun/Eshu), which argues for a deliberate tradition-key review rather than more case-by-case flags. TWO DELIBERATE NON-ADDITIONS: the Tonsured Maize God is identified by the treatments with Hun Hunahpu, already present, and Chac Chel is already an alias on maya_ix_chel; both are ALIAS rows rather than the duplicate this programme forbids. LETTER-LABEL RULE: where a Schellhas or Palenque label has been resolved to a name the name is primary and the label an alias (K'awiil/God K/GII, Pauahtun/God N); where it has not -- God L, GI, GIII -- the label IS the record's name, because inventing a reading would be worse. FOUR CONTRADICTIONS CARRIED: GII's Palenque birth date (28 vs 6 November 2360 BC); Tecun Uman's death (12 vs 20 February 1524); Itzamnaaj Bahlam's numbering at Yaxchilan (II vs III); Kan Ek's death (execution vs disease). 10 REJECT are collectives and offices (the four hundred boys, the Xibalbans, the Bacabs as a class, the four Chaacs, Ah Kin, Halach Uinic, Nacom, the wayob) -- the four named Bacabs are ingested individually and the class is not. 25 BLOCKED in three kinds: list-only deities (Acat, Kinich Kakmo, Ah Peku, Ah Tabai, Ah Kin Xoc, Ix Chup) under the same caution the Aztec pass applied to the Mexica lists; ambiguous referents (Ix Chebel Yax may or may not be Ix Chel; Itzam Cab Ain may or may not be Itzamna; Nim Ac and Nima Tziis may be epithets of two records already held); and named-but-empty figures who appear in this batch's own records as somebody's parent or antagonist with nothing else retrievable -- Spearthrower Owl is the one worth escalating, as he is the Teotihuacan figure behind the 378 entrada and may belong to a Teotihuacan lane. Two further blocks are scoping: the remaining Tikal and Copan king-lists, and the 1847 Caste War leaders. 10 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-10/maya-census.tsv and maya-audit.md.

First Chinese pass. 48 -> 98 records. A 72-name check across the WHOLE registry returned TWO hits and BOTH ARE FALSE -- 'Yanluo Wang' matched buddhist_yama and hindu_yama, figures at the other end of a transmission rather than the Chinese magistrate, and 'Tudigong' matched baule_asie, an unrelated West African earth deity, on a normalised alias. Seventy absences out of seventy-two, the worst hit rate this programme has recorded, in the religious corpus with more adherents and more surviving text than any other in the registry. ABSENT: all three of the Three Pure Ones, who are the highest deities in Daoism, in a corpus holding the Jade Emperor who is below them; SIX OF THE EIGHT IMMORTALS (the registry held Lu Dongbin and He Xiangu, and the Eight are a set that is painted, carved and invoked together); the ENTIRE underworld -- no Yanluo Wang, no Meng Po whose soup of forgetting every Chinese soul drinks, no Zhong Kui, no Ox-Head and Horse-Face, no Black and White Impermanence; the casts of BOTH novels the popular pantheon comes from (Sun Wukong without the pilgrimage, and Li Jing/Nezha/Jinzha/Muzha of the Fengshen Yanyi without Jiang Ziya, who holds the roster by which every god in that book is appointed); Chiyou, Xingtian, Kuafu and Jingwei, the four most-quoted figures in early Chinese myth after the sovereigns the registry did hold; the Four Perils; and Guan Yu and Mazu, who between them have more temples than any other two figures in the Chinese world. 50 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/chinese-expansion.txt. ZERO pre-existing records mutated. PATTERNS REPEATED FROM EARLIER LANES: the famous name without the thing it is defined against, now for the fifth tradition -- Huangdi without Chiyou, Houyi without Xihe whose suns he shot, Shennong without Jingwei his daughter, Guanyin without Red Boy whom she took, Chang'e without Zhu Bajie who was banished for propositioning her; and the group held as a fraction -- two of eight Immortals, three of five Four-Clans culture heroes, one of four Dragon Kings, one of ten Kings of Hell. TWO SCOPING DECISIONS: Chenghuang the City God and Tudigong the Earth God are REJECTED as classes, because the reference treatments define them as the tutelary deity of a particular town or field, multiplied indefinitely -- the same rule that turned away the Ajogun, the Bacabs-as-a-class and the Are Ona Kakanfo, and the census says they are the first ADDs if the owner wants office-deities. The imperial line, two thousand years of emperors absent entirely, is deferred AS A UNIT rather than sampled. DISCLOSURES: fifteen of the fifty come from two sixteenth-century novels and every such record says so on its face rather than presenting a Ming invention as ancient myth. Laozi is an ALIAS on Daode Tianzun and not a record, because the tradition treats the philosopher as a descent of the deity and not the reverse; no position is taken on his historicity. Yanluo Wang is linked counterpart-of to buddhist_yama and NOT merged. NO relation is written between Xihe and Houyi despite his shooting nine of her ten children, because the tradition states none and inventing an enmity would be worse than recording the absence. 11 REJECT are classes and offices. 5 CROSS-TRADITION rows cover the Yama transmission, the false Tudigong/baule_asie match (recorded so the 2-of-72 hit rate is not misread), and Chiyou's claim by the Miao and Hmong, of whom the corpus holds ten records. 15 BLOCKED: named-and-not-retrieved (Taiyi Jiuku Tianzun, Houtu, Yuelao, Changxi, Longmu, Huang Feihu and the Fengshen middle cast); reciprocals this batch's own records cannot carry (Di Jun for Xihe, Liu Bei and Zhang Fei for Guan Yu, the other three Dragon Kings, the other eight Kings of Hell); and not-searched-and-named-as-such. CONFUCIUS is the notable block -- he has had state temples for two thousand years and is a cult figure on this registry's own terms, and he is absent only because he was not researched in this session and writing him from recall is what this programme does not do. He is a strong ADD for the next pass. 10 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-11/chinese-census.tsv and chinese-audit.md.

First Japanese pass. 48 -> 95 records. A 61-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 10 hits and 51 absences, six of the ten being deliberate controls and two of the remaining four FALSE POSITIVES: 'Takemikazuchi' matched japanese_kojiki_takemikazuchi_miwa, who is a human scion of the Miwa line and not the thunder kami of Kashima (the new record is given a distinguishing id), and 'Bishamonten'/'Emma' matched buddhist_vaishravana and buddhist_yama, the Indian ends of two transmissions. THE BASELINE OF 48 WAS MISLEADING: roughly twenty of the 48 are a single late-Heian Minamoto genealogy (Yoshiie through Yoritomo and Yoshitsune) and another seven a Kojiki mythohistorical sub-branch around the Miwa line, so the kami pantheon proper was about twenty records. What it was missing was structure rather than ornament. ABSENT: all five Kotoamatsukami, including Ame-no-Minakanushi, who is the first being in the Kojiki and therefore the first sentence of Japanese literature; the whole rock-cave cast except the goddess who hid and the goddess who danced -- no Omoikane whose plan it was, no Ame-no-Tajikarao who opened the door, no Ishikoridome who made the mirror, no Tamanooya who strung the jewels, no Ame-no-Koyane and Futodama who did the divination and are the ancestral deities of the two clans that ran Japanese court ritual for a thousand years; Yamata-no-Orochi and Kushinada-hime and her parents, in a corpus holding Susanoo; BOTH ENVOYS AND BOTH SONS of the kuni-yuzuri, so the transaction the imperial house's legitimacy rests on had one party present; the entire Hyuga cycle between Ninigi and Jimmu, so the descent from Amaterasu broke off two generations short of arriving; Jimmu, Yamato Takeru and Empress Jingu; five of the Seven Lucky Gods; and Tenjin, the most widely worshipped deified human in Japan. 47 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/japanese-expansion.txt. ONE PRE-EXISTING RECORD MODIFIED: japanese_konohanasakuya_hime gains the reciprocal sibling edge to the new Iwanaga-hime, because the two sisters are defined entirely against each other -- blossom and rock -- and the Kojiki's point is that sending the rock back traded the imperial line's immortality for its looks. 13 inserted lines in data-sources/transcripts/a577b80600b7956a8.txt and nothing else touched. DELIBERATE NON-ACTIONS: yokai are not ingested as classes (tengu, kappa, kitsune, oni, tanuki are REJECT rows; the three NAMED yokai -- Shuten-doji, Tamamo-no-Mae, Yamata-no-Orochi -- are records). Ojin is NOT added, because he is deified as Hachiman, whom the registry holds and whose own record derives the name from the eight banners at Ojin's birth; Jingu's mother-of edge points at the Hachiman record. Bishamonten is linked counterpart-of to buddhist_vaishravana and not merged. THE BUDDHIST/JAPANESE KEY SPLIT IS NOT RESOLVED and is escalated: Kannon, Jizo, Amida, Fudo Myoo and Emma are BLOCKED on it, not on evidence. This is the FIFTH LANE RUNNING to raise a tradition-key question (Canaanite, Yoruba, Maya, Chinese, Japanese), which is a pattern rather than five coincidences and argues for a deliberate review. FOUR CONTRADICTIONS CARRIED: the first kami (Ame-no-Minakanushi in the Kojiki, Kuninotokotachi in the Nihon Shoki -- a live political question for a thousand years, and both are records); who killed the food goddess (Susanoo in the Kojiki, Tsukuyomi in the Nihon Shoki, where the murder is why sun and moon are never in the sky together); who exposed Tamamo-no-Mae (Seimei or his successor Yasunari); and Jimmu's historicity (660 BC per the chronicles, no evidence per the historians). 11 REJECT are kinds, categories, places and objects. 13 BLOCKED, of which two are worth escalating: SUKUNABIKONA, one of the best-known figures in the Izumo material, whose neighbours the same search returned and who it did not; and EMPEROR SUTOKU, the third of the three greatest yokai, which this batch therefore holds as two of three -- the exact fault it has spent five traditions objecting to. Both are strong ADDs for a second pass. The Kintaro identification with Sakata no Kintoki is standard in Japan, was not returned by the sources consulted, and is blocked rather than asserted. 4 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-12/japanese-census.tsv and japanese-audit.md.

First Norse pass. 67 -> 101 records. A 51-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 11 hits and 40 absences; eight of the eleven were deliberate controls and the other three are FALSE -- 'Sol' matched roman_sol, 'Mani' matched nuer_mani, 'Nerthus' matched continental_germanic_nerthus. THE HEADLINE ABSENCE, and the eighth tradition running to show it: THE REGISTRY HELD SIGURD AND NOT THE DRAGON. No Fafnir. No Regin, who forged the sword and set him on; no Otr, whose skin fixed the price; no Hreidmarr, who demanded it; no Andvari, whose ring carries the curse. The corpus already held the ENTIRE Volsung cycle -- Sigurd, Brynhildr, Gudrun, Sigmund, Signy, Sinfjotli, Svanhild, Jormunrekkr and a dozen more, all of whom die because of a bag of gold paid for an otter -- and it did not hold the gold, the otter or the dragon. NOT ASSERTED: no relation between Gullveig and Freyja, no identification of Lodurr with Loki, and no explanation of why Utgarda-Loki shares a name with Loki -- all three are scholarly proposals and this programme does not write edges on proposals. 10 REJECT are categories, collectives, a tree, and four named horses identified only by a name and an owner (Sleipnir is ingested because the sources give him a parent and a biography). 11 BLOCKED, of which FOUR are strong ADDs held only for want of a retrievable citation and are flagged upward: GARMR, the hound at Gnipahellir; VAFTHRUDNIR, who contests wisdom with Odin over a whole Eddic poem; ASK AND EMBLA, the first humans; and GYLFI, who is both the king in the Gefjon story and the frame narrator of the Gylfaginning. Each was searched alongside figures that did come back. ONE CORRECTION THE TEST SUITE FORCED: Skoll and Hati were first written at era 'primordial', on the reasoning that the sun and moon they chase are primordial; npm test rejected it, because both have parentIds [norse_fenrir] and Fenrir is filed at mythic-prehistoric, and a parent cannot be later than a child. First Slavic pass. 18 -> 41 records; Slavic was the SMALLEST holding of any tradition in this corpus with a literature. THE HEADLINE ABSENCE: THE REGISTRY HELD FIVE OF THE SIX IDOLS OF KIEV. The Primary Chronicle's entry for 980 names Perun, Khors, Dazhbog, Stribog, Simargl and Mokosh -- the only place an East Slavic ruler's own pantheon is enumerated -- and the registry held all of them except KHORS, who is the most frequently mentioned Slavic god after Perun. Five-of-six is worse than none, because a corpus with a hole in the middle of its only enumerated pantheon looks complete. METHODOLOGICAL FINDING, PROPOSED AS STANDARD FOR EVERY REMAINING LANE: the lane opened with a 48-name sweep (19 hits, 29 absences, every hit a deliberate control) which produced the first 19 records; the sweep was then RE-RUN, widened to 92 names, AFTER those records were in the corpus, and returned Khors, Yarovit, Prove and Podaga -- all absent, all chronicle-attested. A sweep tests the registry against the author's recall, so the names checked first are the names that came to mind first; re-running it once the obvious names are satisfied surfaces what the first pass crowded out. Block VI of the transcript is the argument. ALSO ABSENT: the RUGEN TEMPLES -- Svetovid of Arkona (four heads, a horn read for the harvest, a temple Saxo described and the Danes destroyed in 1168), Rugievit, Porevit and Porenut. These are the BEST-ATTESTED Slavic deities there are, because a hostile eyewitness wrote down what the statues looked like before knocking them over, and the registry instead held the reconstructed abstractions Belobog, Chernobog, Rod and Lada. Three more chronicle-attested West Slavic gods: Yarovit, whose Wolgast temple held a giant shield instead of a statue and was destroyed in 1128, and Prove and Podaga, Helmold's two Wagrian gods -- one an oak grove with no image, the other an image with no grove. THE SEASONAL CYCLE: the registry held Marzanna, who is winter and death, and nothing she acts on -- not Jarilo, whom she marries and murders every year; not Ziva; not Kupala. THE FOLKLORE: no Baba Yaga, no Koschei, and no ZMEY GORYNYCH in a registry holding DOBRYNYA NIKITICH, whose one defining deed is killing that dragon -- the ninth tradition running to show that exact fault. THE BYLINA CAST: the three bogatyrs were joined to each other and to nothing else, with no court to serve at, no opponent, and neither Svyatogor nor Mikula Selyaninovich, the two figures the epic treats as stronger than all three. THE BIRD-MAIDENS: Alkonost, Sirin, Gamayun. 23 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/slavic-expansion.txt. ZERO pre-existing records mutated: every symmetric relation is reciprocated inside the batch and every edge toward a pre-existing record uses a non-symmetric kind, chosen because it is also truer -- Jarilo consort-of and killed-by Marzanna (a marriage that lasts one season and ends in a murder), Zmey Gorynych slain-by Dobrynya, Solovei defeated-by Ilya, Vladimir overlord-of each of the three bogatyrs, Khors co-enshrined-with each of the other five Kiev idols (a joint erection in 980, not kinship or alliance), Prove and Podaga named-alongside (a textual relation, labelled as one). SCOPE DECISIONS TAKEN EXPLICITLY: household and landscape spirits are CLASSES and are REJECT rows (domovoi, rusalka, leshy, vodyanoy, bannik, kikimora, vila, poludnitsa, chort, likho, upyr, bereginya, rozhanitsy) -- there is a domovoi behind every stove, not one Domovoi; the three BIRD-MAIDENS are not classes and go in as three records. LEL AND POLEL ARE REJECTED WHERE DEVANA IS INGESTED, and the distinction is argued: both come from Dlugosz, but dziewanna is an independent Polish plant-name with a life outside him and lelum polelum is a burden in a song. VESNA is not ingested and is NOT made an alias of Ziva -- that equation is modern and neither source makes it. The Firebird is an ITEMS question; Sivka-Burka is a named horse identified only by a name and an owner, the exact ground on which four Norse horses were rejected in lane 13. WEIGHT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: Jarilo medium (no medieval text tells the story; it is Katicic and Belaj's twentieth-century reconstruction from spring songs), Kupala medium (the festival is old and pagan, the god is probably a back-formation from its name), Podaga medium, DEVANA LOW (Dlugosz supplies a Slavic Jupiter, Ceres, Pluto and Diana, in order, which is not how pantheons are found). NOT ASSERTED: no edge between Yarovit and Jarilo despite the shared jar- root, because that is a scholarly proposal; no edge between Baba Yaga and Koschei, because sharing a tale is not a relation; no sun-or-moon ruling on Khors; no identification of the epic Vladimir with Vladimir Svyatoslavich, and no dates on him; no Volkhova or Lyubava on Sadko, because both are Rimsky-Korsakov's 1898 opera and not the bylina; no sphere for Prove beyond his cult and no domains at all for Podaga. 16 BLOCKED, of which FOUR are strong ADDs flagged upward: KIY, SHCHEK, KHORIV AND LYBID, the legendary founders of Kiev, from the same source this batch used for Khors; VOLGA SVYATOSLAVICH, Mikula's usual companion, so the batch ingests Mikula without his pair; MAT SYRA ZEMLYA, Moist Mother Earth, whom both the Svyatogor and Mikula records turn on; and TURUPIT, PURUVIT AND KAREVIT of the Knytlinga saga, which would complete a Rugen set this batch holds four of. RADEGAST IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF BLOCKER AND THE MOST INTERESTING ROW IN THE CENSUS: Helmold places him at Rethra and Thietmar places Zuarasici -- Svarozhich, ALREADY IN THE CORPUS -- at the same sanctuary, and the two are widely identified, so ingesting Radegast could duplicate an existing record under a second name. Blocked until a treatment rules on it. Marya Morevna, Vasilisa and Ivan Tsarevich are blocked on a SCOPE question rather than on evidence -- whether a tale-type role filled by a differently-named character in each variant is an individual for this registry -- which also gates Koschei's relations. 7 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. FOR THE NEXT PASS: the era vocabulary invites historical rulers (kievan-rus-historical is registered and holds nothing but the epic Vladimir added here), and the Baltic keys hold the cognate figures at small counts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-14/slavic-census.tsv and slavic-audit.md.

First Zoroastrian pass. 33 -> 70 records. THE HEADLINE ABSENCE: THE REGISTRY DID NOT HOLD ZARATHUSTRA. A 95-name check returned 13 hits and 82 absences; six of the thirteen were aliases already carried on existing records (Jamshid on Yima, Zahhak on Azhi Dahaka, Fereydun on Thraetaona, Garshasp on Keresaspa, Bahman on Vohu Manah, Anahita on Aredvi Sura Anahita) and two were FALSE ('Indra' matched the Hindu god rather than the Zoroastrian arch-daeva of the same name; 'Vata' matched hindu_vayu). The corpus held Ahura Mazda, Angra Mainyu, all six Amesha Spentas, nine yazatas and fifteen figures of the Iranian legendary cycle, and not the prophet the religion is named after -- nor ANY of the handful of human beings the Gathas name: not Vishtaspa his patron, not Jamasp, not Frashaoshtra, not his daughter Pouruchista. FOUR MORE STRUCTURAL HOLES OF THE SAME SHAPE. (1) ALL SIX AMESHA SPENTAS WERE PRESENT AND ALL SIX OF THEIR OPPONENTS WERE ABSENT: the Vendidad sets Aka Manah against Vohu Manah, Indra against Asha Vahishta, Saurva against Khshathra Vairya, Nanghaithya against Spenta Armaiti, Taurvi against Haurvatat, Zairich against Ameretat -- six for six, which in a dualist religion is half the system. (2) TISHTRYA WAS HELD WITH AN EMPTY RELATIONS ARRAY and his entire myth is a horse-fight with APAOSHA for the waters of Vourukasha: the registry held a fight with one fighter in it, which is the cleanest instance yet of the pattern this programme has found in ten traditions. (3) NO CREATION ACCOUNT AT ALL -- no Gayomart the first man, no Mashya and Mashyana, no Gavaevodata the sole-created ox. (4) NO ESCHATOLOGY -- no Saoshyant, no Hushedar, no Hushedar-mah, in the religion most often credited with introducing a world with a datable end. A NEW VARIETY OF THE RECURRING FAULT: THE CORPUS HELD THE BORROWER AND NOT THE LENDER. Aeshma, the demon of wrath, was absent while jewish_ashmedai -- Asmodeus, the figure Aeshma is generally taken to stand behind -- was already held. Every previous instance of this finding has been a gap within one tradition; this one runs across two. No equated-with edge is drawn, because the treatment describes a likely derivation rather than an identity and the kind is symmetric. THE SHAHNAMEH WAS HELD FROM THE MIDDLE. ZAL WAS HELD WITH AN EMPTY parentIds ARRAY and his son Rostam with both parents named, so two generations above Rostam the genealogy simply stopped in a corpus whose whole subject is descent; this batch adds Sam, who abandoned Zal in the Alborz for being born white-haired, Nariman his father, and the Simurgh, who found the child and raised him. AFRASIAB, king of Turan and chief antagonist of the entire epic and already in the Avesta as Frangrasyan, was absent in a corpus holding five figures whose stories are all about him. Tahmineh, Sohrab's mother, was absent. Salm, Tur and Iraj were absent, so the quarrel that makes Iran and Turan enemies had no parties in it. Kaveh the blacksmith was absent -- the one commoner in a cycle the registry held only the kings and heroes of. METHOD: THE SWEEP WAS RUN TWICE, as lane 14 proposed as standard. First sweep 95 names, 13 hits, 82 absences. Second sweep 168 names, run AFTER the 37 records were generated: 95 hits, 73 absences, all 37 new records resolving. Honest report: in lane 14 the re-run found four ingestible figures; here it found a better BLOCKED list (Pourushaspa and Dughdova, Hvovi, Hutaosa, Vivanghant, Hushang and Tahmuras). Both are worth the cost. ZERO pre-existing records mutated; every edge toward a pre-existing record uses a non-symmetric kind. Six arch-daevas 'opposes' their six Amesha Spentas; Apaosha defeated-by Tishtrya (direction matters, because Apaosha wins the first round); Gayomart slain-by Angra Mainyu; Daena presents-the-soul-before Mithra, Sraosha and Rashnu, completing a Chinvat tribunal the corpus held three quarters of; Sam father-of Zal AND, as a separate edge, Sam abandoned Zal, because the abandonment is not an incident of the fatherhood but the event the whole Sistan cycle proceeds from; Simurgh foster-parent-of Zal; Tahmineh mother-of Sohrab; Afrasiab manipulated Sohrab; Kaveh rebelled-against Azhi Dahaka; Zurvan progenitor-of-in-zurvanite-doctrine Ahura Mazda and Angra Mainyu, a kind that names the doctrine inside itself because the claim is true only within it, with nothing entered in anyone's parentIds; Tur ancestor-of Afrasiab rather than father-of, because one treatment makes Tur his father directly and the Shahnameh puts Pashang between them. CONTRADICTIONS CARRIED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: the lists of the six arch-daevas DO NOT AGREE -- one substitutes Nasu for Aka Manah -- so Nasu is ingested on his own footing with NO opposes edge, because drawing one would mean picking his slot; Gayomart is the first man in the Bundahishn and the first king in the epic, and both are on the record; Afrasiab's genealogy as above. NOT ASSERTED: no date for Zarathustra, because the question spans roughly a thousand years of serious proposals and any date would pick a side; no identification of Vishtaspa with Hystaspes the father of Darius, which is a pivot of that same dating question; no sibling edge between Jamasp and Frashaoshtra, because the source says clan and not brothers; no cross-tradition edge from the daeva Indra to hindu_indra or from Nanghaithya to the Ashvins, because three of the six arch-daevas carrying Vedic god-names is a fact about two traditions and not a relation between two individuals; no sibling edges among the three saviours, who share a father and a lake and are two thousand years apart. TRADITION-KEY QUESTION RAISED FOR THE SEVENTH LANE RUNNING: the corpus holds sogdian_zurvan and this batch adds zoroastrian_zurvan WITHOUT MERGING, on the precedent the corpus itself sets by holding zoroastrian_mithra and roman_mithraic_mysteries_mithras separately. Merging is destructive and irreversible and is the owner's call. TWO ANIMALS INGESTED AND ONE REJECTED ON A STATED RULE: Gavaevodata and the Simurgh go in; RAKHSH, Rostam's horse, is a REJECT row on exactly the ground that rejected four Norse horses in lane 13 and Sivka-Burka in lane 14 -- identified only by a name and an owner. The ox is a singular created being with a cosmogonic role and its own death; the Simurgh has a will, a moral decision and a household. 20 BLOCKED, of which SEVEN are strong ADDs, and the first two are this lane's own fault one generation up: POURUSHASPA AND DUGHDOVA, the prophet's own parents, added-without; HVOVI, his wife and in the tradition the daughter of Frashaoshtra, who IS ingested here; VIVANGHANT, Yima's father, in a corpus holding Yima with no parents; HUSHANG AND TAHMURAS, so the corpus holds the third king of a dynasty and not the first two; MANUCHEHR, who avenges Iraj, so the batch adds the crime and not the reckoning; ESFANDIYAR, searched twice without a retrievable treatment; and HVARE-KHSHAETA AND MAH, the sun and the moon, in a corpus that now holds Tishtrya and Apaosha. TWO BLOCKERS ARE SCHEMA QUESTIONS RATHER THAN RESEARCH QUESTIONS AND ARE ESCALATED: the tradition's registered era vocabulary is 'primordial | legendary' and NOTHING ELSE, so Kartir, Adurbad, Tansar, Mazdak and the ENTIRE SASANIAN HALF OF THE SHAHNAMEH -- Ardashir, Bahram Gur, Khosrow Parviz, Shirin, Bahram Chobin -- have no era to be filed in. Compare lane 14, where the Slavic vocabulary registers kievan-rus-historical and holds almost nothing in it. Both are one decision for the owner and it gates more candidates than any citation gap in this census. ONE FURTHER OBSERVATION: the registry's Iranian holdings are overwhelmingly male, and Bizhan and Manizheh, Sudabeh and Gordafarid are where that would begin to change. 4 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts; two others that would have been kinless were given properly cited edges instead. PARTIAL. The obvious next pass is Yasht-by-Yasht. See audits/lane-15/zoroastrian-census.tsv and zoroastrian-audit.md.

First Hindu pass, taking the CONFLICTS. 133 -> 177 records. THE HEADLINE: THE REGISTRY HELD THE PANDAVAS AND NOT THE KAURAVAS. A 138-name check returned 17 hits and 121 absences; SIX of the seventeen hits are FALSE -- 'Uttara' matched mon_uttara, 'Kurma' matched fur_kuruma, 'Sati' matched egyptian_satis, 'Mangala' matched mandinka_maa_ngala, 'Ila' matched koryak_illa, and 'Bali' matched hindu_vali, the VANARA king of the Ramayana rather than the asura king of the Vamana story. The 133 records were not thinly spread -- the corpus holds FIVE SONS OF KARNA -- but it held no other side of anything. All five Pandavas, Draupadi, Kunti, Madri, Pandu, Dhritarashtra, Bhishma, Vyasa, Drupada, Dhrishtadyumna, Abhimanyu and Karna were there. NOT ONE KAURAVA. No Duryodhana, no Gandhari, no Dushasana, no Shakuni, no Vikarna -- and none of the men the war is fought by on that side: no Drona, who taught BOTH houses, no Kripa, no Ashwatthama, no Kritavarma, no Jayadratha. The Mahabharata is a war between two families and the registry held one of them. THE SAME FAULT FOUR MORE TIMES, IN THE GOD-AND-ADVERSARY PAIRS: Indra without VRITRA, whose killing gives Indra his standing Rigvedic epithet Vritrahan; Durga without MAHISHASURA, whose killing gives her her commonest cult name Mahishasuramardini; Narasimha without HIRANYAKASHIPU, in an avatar that exists for that one killing and no other; Varaha without HIRANYAKSHA, likewise. TWO OF THOSE GODS ARE NAMED AFTER THE BEING THEY KILL and the registry held the name and not the being. Also absent: PRAHLADA, the boy the Narasimha avatar comes to save. DITI states it most precisely -- the corpus held Kashyapa and held ADITI, mother of the gods, and not Diti, mother of their opponents by the same father. The registry's Hindu holdings were a family tree with the losing side pruned. DASHARATHA HAD THREE QUEENS AND THE CORPUS HELD TWO: Kausalya and Sumitra, the two whose sons it ALREADY HELD, and not KAIKEYI, whose two boons exile Rama for fourteen years, which is the event the Ramayana consists of. That is lane 14's five-of-six pattern with a MECHANISM rather than bad luck: a corpus that adds people because other people it holds are related to them reaches a queen through her son and stops where no son is held. The rest of the Ramayana's missing half follows: Manthara, Mandodari, Shurpanakha, Maricha, Tataka, Ahalya -- and VALMIKI, who wrote the poem, in a corpus holding twenty-odd of its characters AND holding Vyasa, the other epic's author, with his parents and his sons. THE TWO HOUSES HAD NO COMMON ANCESTOR. The corpus held the Kurus back to Pratipa and the Yadavas back to Shura and nothing above either, so the two families the epic is about had no reason in the data to be related. They descend from YAYATI by two wives: Devayani's son YADU founds the Yadavas and Sharmishtha's son PURU founds the line that becomes the Kurus. Seven records and they are cousins in the data rather than only in the story. METHOD, SWEEP RUN TWICE: first 138 names, 17 hits, 121 absences; second 242 names after generation, 99 hits, 143 absences, all 44 new records resolving. The second sweep produced the strongest blocked rows -- KURU himself, eponym of the Kauravas and of Kurukshetra; SHAKUNTALA, DUSHYANTA and the Bharata the COUNTRY is named after, where the corpus holds a DIFFERENT Bharata; DUSHALA, the Kauravas' one daughter and Jayadratha's wife; and the whole SOLAR DYNASTY, so the corpus cannot say that Rama is an Ikshvaku. ZERO pre-existing records mutated; every edge toward an existing record is non-symmetric. Kaikeyi exiled Rama is one edge and it is the Ramayana. Gandhari intervened-for Draupadi: the two women stand on opposite sides of the hall in the epic's worst scene and the one who stops it is the mother of the men who caused it. Duryodhana befriended-by Karna: the corpus held Karna and five of his sons and not the man whose friendship explains his position. Kaikeyi mother-of Bharata as a RELATION, because the corpus holds Bharata with parentIds naming Dasharatha alone -- exactly the asymmetry lane 15 found with Sohrab. TWO CORRECTIONS THE TEST SUITE FORCED. (1) ASHWATTHAMA'S TYPE: authored demigod on the sources making him a combined incarnation of Shiva, Yama, Kama and Krodha; npm test rejected it as tier-classification drift, because this corpus computes the tier from DESCENT and both his parents are mortals. Corrected to mortal; the incarnation claim stays in the lifecycle. (2) THE DETAIL-SHARD SIZE TRIPWIRE FIRED AND THE PRE-AGREED RESPONSE EXECUTED: test/scale-gates.test.cjs budgets each lazily-fetched detail shard at 150KB gz and at 6,362 figures bucket 8 reached 151KB. The documented response for that tripwire is 'BUCKETS steps up via the deterministic formula', so bucketCountFor() in scripts/build-tiers.cjs had its per-shard target moved from 100 to 80, taking the corpus from 64 shards to 128. THIS IS A CORRECTION TO THE FORMULA'S OWN ASSUMPTION, NOT A BUMP TO GREEN A BUILD: the formula's comment claimed 100 records a shard would fit the budget and real data falsified it, because the hash does not distribute evenly -- average 99.4 a shard while the largest was over. After the step-up the largest shard is 79.9KB and the median 56.4KB, and the documented 30k -> 512 anchor is unchanged. test/tiers.test.cjs mirrors the same constant and was updated with it; NO test was skipped, disabled or quarantined, and the assertion still requires the bucket count to follow the formula exactly. LOAD-TIME INVARIANTS RE-CHECKED: shards are fetched lazily per figure-open so more of them means FEWER bytes per open and nothing added to first load; dist/site/index.html is 40.4KB gz and its app-<hash>.js is still deferred. RESTRAINT MADE VISIBLE: the BLINDFOLD IS NOT ON GANDHARI'S RECORD, because it is not in the treatments consulted; Dushasana's record does not narrate the disrobing; Vikarna's does not say he objected to it; Shishupala's does not give the hundred offences or the beheading; Ahalya's curse is recorded as 'a curse' and not as the turning-to-stone, because the versions differ and whether she was complicit is what the tradition argues about for two thousand years. Puru and Yadu are 'sibling' and not 'half sibling' because the treatment states the shared father without using either term, and parentRoles carry the actual mothers. TWO WITHIN-TRADITION ID COLLISIONS, both handled with qualified ids rather than silent merges: hindu_chitrasena_kaurava, because hindu_chitrasena_karna already exists; and hindu_mahabali, because hindu_vali is the vanara king. Both are WITHIN one tradition, not across two, which is new. 20 BLOCKED. Strong ADDs in order of how badly they are missed: KURU himself; SHAKUNTALA, DUSHYANTA and BHARATA; SATI, DAKSHA and ANDHAKA, so a corpus holding Shiva and Parvati has something of the cycle connecting them; THE NAVAGRAHA, of which the corpus holds none as grahas and which are the most widely worshipped set of figures in living practice; THE SOLAR DYNASTY; and EKALAVYA. ESCALATED AND NOT A FIGURE: the corpus files hindu_dhritarashtra at era 'epic-period' and his nephews the Pandavas at 'dvapara-yuga', which is EARLIER in the registered Hindu era order, so the Kauravas added here are filed at epic-period to match their father and FIRST COUSINS NOW SIT IN TWO DIFFERENT ERAS. This batch declines to fix a pre-existing inconsistency by mutating records it did not author; it will recur in every future Mahabharata pass. Zero kinless figures - every one of the 44 carries an edge. PARTIAL. Hindu is still the largest absolute gap in this corpus at 177 records. See audits/lane-16/hindu-census.tsv and hindu-audit.md.

Second Hindu pass, working the list lane 16's audit named. 177 -> 208 records. THE CORPUS HELD NONE OF THE NINE GRAHAS AS GRAHAS. The Navagraha are the most widely worshipped set of figures in living Hindu practice - a Navagraha shrine stands in most substantial temples in southern India - and the corpus held Surya and Soma for other reasons and lane 16 added Shukra for his part in two stories. Mangala, Budha, Brihaspati, Shani, Rahu and Ketu were absent. WITH THIS BATCH THE CORPUS HOLDS ALL NINE INDIVIDUALLY. RAHU AND KETU ARE ONE BEING CUT IN HALF: the asura Svarbhanu drank the nectar in disguise, Vishnu took his head off with the discus before it could pass his throat, and because the nectar had already reached him BOTH HALVES ARE IMMORTAL - the head is Rahu, the body is Ketu, and the eclipse is the head swallowing the sun. The corpus held the sun, the moon and the discus and neither half of the thing that eats them. The registry has no vocabulary for that relation, because nothing else in the corpus is two records that were one body; the kind 'severed-half-of' is invented for it. The tradition assigns the two halves OPPOSITE DISPOSITIONS - the head grasping at the world, the body turned away - and that is on both records rather than summarised on one. THE CHURNING OF THE OCEAN, OF WHICH THE CORPUS HELD NO PART: not KURMA the tortoise who holds the mountain up, not VASUKI the naga used as the rope, not DHANVANTARI who rises with the pot and is the patron deity of Ayurveda, not MOHINI, the form Vishnu takes to get the nectar back and therefore the direct cause of Rahu's beheading - so two records in this batch describe the same minute from two sides. KURMA WAS A BLOCKED ROW IN LANE 16, held for want of a treatment that gave him an act rather than a place in a list; this pass retrieved one. FIRST TIME IN THIS PROGRAMME THAT A BLOCKED ROW FROM ONE LANE HAS BEEN CLEARED BY THE NEXT, which is the argument for keeping blocked rows rather than rejecting them. TWO HOUSEHOLDS FINISHED, on the pattern lane 16 named - the corpus holds the god and not the household. SURYA HAD TWO WIVES AND THE CORPUS HELD NEITHER: Sanjna, who could not bear his heat, and CHHAYA, the shadow she left in her place, who is Shani's mother - a cast shadow with a household, children and a will of her own, whom the tradition treats as a person throughout. SOMA HAD A WIFE AND THE CORPUS HELD NEITHER HER NOR THE SON: Tara, taken from Brihaspati, returned pregnant, mother of Budha. THE DAKSHA CYCLE: the corpus holds Shiva and Parvati and held nothing of what stands between them - Daksha, who holds a sacrifice and does not invite his daughter's husband; Sati, who burns herself in the fire of it; and Virabhadra, whom Shiva tears out of his own hair to go and behead him. NO EDGE IS DRAWN FROM SATI TO PARVATI: that Parvati is Sati reborn is a claim about identity across lives, this registry has no kind for it, and inventing one would commit the corpus to a position on rebirth that would then apply to the avatars, the jatakas and every tradition with reincarnation in it. THE REGISTRY HELD THE BENEFICIARY OF AN ACCIDENT AND NOT THE INTENDED RECIPIENT. (3) GWYN AP NUDD HELD WITH AN EMPTY RELATIONS ARRAY: his one story is that he and GWYTHYR fight for CREIDDYLAD every May Day until Judgement Day, and the corpus held neither the other man nor the woman. By the end of the twelfth century GIRALDUS CAMBRENSIS DISTINGUISHES THEM IN AS MANY WORDS: Merlinus Ambrosius, found at Carmarthen, fatherless, who prophesies the two dragons before Vortigern; and Merlinus Silvester or Celidonius, a northerner, contemporary of Arthur, driven mad at Arfderydd and living out his life in the Caledonian forest. First Finnish pass. 26 -> 53 records. THE HEADLINE: THE OLDEST WRITTEN LIST OF FINNISH GODS IS FROM 1551 AND THE CORPUS HELD A THIRD OF IT. In 1551 Mikael Agricola prefaced his Finnish Psalter with a verse catalogue of the gods of Hame and of Karelia, twelve to a region, each with its function in a line or two - THE OLDEST WRITTEN RECORD OF FINNISH RELIGION THERE IS, and the reason Agricola is called the father of the study of it. Of the twenty-four the registry held EIGHT: Tapio, Ahti, Vainamoinen, Ilmarinen, Ukko, Pellonpekko as finnish_pekko, Nyrckes as finnish_nyyrikki, and Hiisi - the last under the KARELIAN key. It did not hold RAHKO who split the Moon black, LIEKKIO lord of grass roots and trees, RONGOTEUS who gave the rye, VIRANKANNOS who guarded the oats, AKRAS who made peas beans and turnips and brought forth cabbage flax and hemp, KONDOS who made the burn-clearings and the ploughlands, RAUNI the consort of Ukko, KEKRI who increased the growth of the cattle, or VEDEN EMO who drove the fish into the net. Nine named gods with stated provinces from the one document that makes pre-Christian Finland legible at all: THE CORPUS HAD THE HEROES OF A NINETEENTH-CENTURY EPIC AND ALMOST NONE OF THE GODS OF THE SIXTEENTH-CENTURY LIST. All nine are now in it. Six of the remaining seven are REJECTED WITH REASONS - Kratti, Tonttu, Piru and Kapeet are classes of spirit or collectives and the Kalevanpojat are a collective of unnamed sons, the rejection lane 18 applied to the Fianna and lane 19 to the Coraniaid; Kaleva himself IS ingested, because the epic is named after him. AND THE TWELFTH IS THE FINDING: Hittavainen, last in the Karelian list, is generally read as Huittavainen, that is SAINT HUBERT, patron of hunters. THERE IS A CATHOLIC SAINT INSIDE THE OLDEST LIST OF FINNISH GODS, put there by the bishop who was writing the list to condemn it. THE KALEVALA HAS FIFTY CANTOS AND THE CORPUS HELD THE CAST OF FORTY-NINE. MARJATTA eats a lingonberry, conceives, and bears a son in a stable; the child is lost and found in a swamp; Vainamoinen judges that a fatherless boy should be taken out and killed, and THE TWO-WEEK-OLD INFANT ANSWERS HIM BACK and reproaches him for the judgement; the boy is baptised King of Karelia by Virokannas and Vainamoinen sings himself a boat of copper and leaves the world. That is how the epic ends, and the corpus held Vainamoinen with TEN relations on him and neither the woman nor the child who end his age. NEITHER RECORD SAYS THE CHILD IS CHRIST: readers have said so for two centuries and the canto plainly invites it, and what the poem states is that a fatherless child born in a stable is made king and the old singer leaves. HE IS UNNAMED IN THE POEM AND THE RECORD DOES NOT INVENT A NAME - the id is a patronymic and the primary name is the phrase the poem uses. THE SAMPO IS FORGED FOR A WOMAN THE CORPUS DID NOT HOLD. The price Louhi sets for the Sampo is her daughter, and the registry held LOUHI, held ILMARINEN who forges it, held VAINAMOINEN who is refused, and did not hold THE MAIDEN OF POHJOLA, who is what the forging is FOR. She sits on the rainbow weaving cloth of gold; she sets Vainamoinen the task of tying an egg in invisible knots; she marries Ilmarinen; she bakes a stone into the bread of Kullervo, he breaks his father knife on it and sends the beasts that kill her; and her death is why Ilmarinen forges the golden bride. THE CORPUS HELD KULLERVO AND HIS REVENGE AND NOT THE PERSON HE TOOK IT ON. She is UNNAMED in the epic - Pohjan neiti is a title used throughout in place of a name - and a registry that declined to hold her on that ground would be recording the silence of the poem as the absence of a person, in a corpus that holds the man who forged a mill to marry her. TUONI HAD FIVE DAUGHTERS AND THE CORPUS HELD ONE. finnish_loviatar was in the registry with parentIds naming Tuoni and Tuonetar; KALMA whose name is the smell of a corpse, KIVUTAR who boils pain in a pot, KIPUTYTTO who sits on the pain-stone at Kipumaki where three rivers meet, and VAMMATAR were not. This is the Ernmas finding of lane 18 exactly, one tradition later - the mother, the father, the famous daughter and none of the rest - and it costs the same thing: LOVIATAR IS THE MOTHER OF THE NINE DISEASES AND THE CORPUS HELD NONE OF THE THREE SISTERS THE SAME POEM INVOKES TO TAKE THEM AWAY. It held the illness and not the cure. KIVUTAR AND KIPUTYTTO ARE TWO RECORDS AND SOME TREATMENTS MAKE THEM ONE: the distinction the sources draw is by act, one boils pain in a pot and the other grinds it into stone, and where a tradition distinguishes two figures this registry holds two, on the ground lane 19 stated for the two Myrddins, with neither record asserting identity nor denying it. THE BEAR IS INGESTED WHERE FIVE HORSES AND TWO HOUNDS WERE REJECTED. OTSO is the opposite case in every particular: the being whose true name may not be spoken, so the tradition addresses him as honey-paw, apple of the forest, king of the forest; born of wool Ukko threw in the sea, or of the Great Bear; given a PEIJAISET after a killing, a funeral staged as a wedding, with his skull raised into a tall pine so his spirit can come back. He is not the bear of any owner, and the sources say in as many words that he is the spirit of all bears rather than one of them. HONGATAR his mother comes with the strongest attestation in the batch: THE PEIJAISET CHANT IS A DIALOGUE AND SHE HAS ONE OF THE TWO PARTS. SURMA is likewise a dog and likewise ingested, because he is death itself with a shape at a threshold and not an animal with an owner. THE TRADITION-KEY PROBLEM, RAISED AGAIN AND SHARPER. The corpus holds a KARELIAN key with seven records of which FOUR ARE THE SAME BEINGS AS FINNISH RECORDS: Vainamoinen and Ilmarinen are held TWICE EACH and Ukko three times counting estonian_uku. This is the programme's recurring finding in its sharpest form yet, sharper than Sigurd without Fafnir in lane 13, because there the corpus held one adversary and here it held none. AND IT DID NOT HOLD A SINGLE DANE. The poem is set in Denmark for two-thirds of its length, in a hall belonging to a king the registry had no record for: no HROTHGAR whose hall the poem is about, no WEALHTHEOW his queen who speaks twice in public about the succession, no UNFERTH who challenges Beowulf at the feast and then lends him a sword, no AESCHERE whose death sends Beowulf into the mere, no SCYLD SCEFING who is THE FIRST PERSON IN THE POEM, no BEOW or HEALFDENE between Scyld and Hrothgar, and no Heorogar, Halga, Hrothulf or Freawaru. THE REGISTRY HELD THE WEAPON'S SECOND OWNER AND NOT ITS FIRST. Nor did it hold ONGENTHEOW who kills the Haethcyn it held, nor ONELA who kills the Heardred it held, nor EOFOR who wins Hygelac's battle for him, nor EADGILS, whose war is THE ONLY ONE BEOWULF FIGHTS THAT IS NOT AGAINST A MONSTER. The Swedish wars are a substantial part of the poem by line count and the corpus held four Geats of them and no Swede at all. BEDE NAMES TWO GODDESSES IN ONE PASSAGE AND THE REGISTRY TOOK ONE. The corpus held EOSTRE, whom Bede names in De temporum ratione as the eponym of Eosturmonath. It did not hold HRETHA, whom Bede names in the same work by the same construction a few lines away: Hrethmonath 'is named for their goddess Hretha, to whom they sacrificed at this time'. SAME AUTHOR, SAME BOOK, SAME SENTENCE-PATTERN, SAME EVIDENTIARY STANDING - and the difference between them is that one gave her name to Easter. That is lane 16's mechanism in its purest form, a corpus that grows by adding the name people know, and it is the cleanest instance this programme has found, because the two goddesses are not merely comparable but CO-ATTESTED. Two more were missing on the same footing: ERCE, called three times in the Aecerbot field-charm - Erce, Erce, Erce, eorthan modor - ONE WORD, THREE TIMES, IN ONE MANUSCRIPT, and the only time an English earth-mother is called by name; and ING, four lines of the Old English Rune Poem, first seen among the East Danes, gone east over the wave with his wagon after him - and the sweep resolved 'Ing' onto norse_freyr because Yngvi is an alias there, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHY THE ENGLISH FIGURE NEEDED A RECORD OF HIS OWN. A CROSS-TRADITION EDGE DRAWN ON AN EVENT AND NOT AN EQUATION. Lane 19 ingested VORTIGERN under the Welsh key; this batch ingests HENGIST and HORSA, the men the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle says he invited in 449, and draws the edge. THIS IS THE FIRST CROSS-TRADITION RELATION THIS PROGRAMME HAS WRITTEN. Eighteen lanes have declined to join Nodens to Nuada, Ing to Yngvi, Mitra to Mithra or Dyaus to Zeus, on the rule that a shared name is a fact about languages and not a relation between beings, AND THAT RULE IS UNTOUCHED. This is a different kind of thing: ONE EVENT THAT TWO LITERATURES RECORD FROM OPPOSITE SIDES, with two different named people on the two ends, and the corpus can now state it from either. TWO MEN NAMED HENGEST, AND THIS BATCH ASSERTS NOTHING ABOUT THEM. Hengest of the Finnsburg episode is a Danish retainer who takes a winter truce with his lord's killer and breaks it in the spring; Hengist of Kent is the Jutish leader who lands in Thanet. Tolkien argued at length that they are one man and others do not. BOTH ARE INGESTED UNDER QUALIFIED IDS, each built only from its own sources - nothing about Kent is on the Finnsburg record and nothing about Finnsburg is on the Kentish one - and they carry a distinguished-by-this-registry-from edge whose note says in as many words that IT ASSERTS ONLY THAT THE REGISTRY HOLDS TWO RECORDS AND WHY. First Continental Germanic pass. 8 -> 34 records. THE HEADLINE: EIGHT GODDESSES AND NOT ONE GOD. A 62-name check returned 14 hits and 48 absences. The Continental Germanic key held eight records and EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS A GODDESS - Baduhenna, Beda, Boudihillia, Fimmilena, Friagabis, Nehalennia, Nerthus and Tamfana, Tacitus and a set of Roman-era altars - and THERE WAS NO GOD IN IT AT ALL. Not WODAN, not DONAR, not SAXNOT, which are THE EXACT LIST A SAXON CONVERT WAS MADE TO RENOUNCE BY NAME in a ninth-century manuscript from Mainz: ec forsacho Uuoden ende Thunaer ende Saxnote. Nor TUISTO and MANNUS, whom Tacitus says the Germanic peoples sang about as their origin and who are therefore THE FIRST GERMANIC FIGURES NAMED IN ANY WRITTEN SOURCE AT ALL. Nor one figure from the MERSEBURG INCANTATIONS, the only surviving text in Old High German that names the heathen gods - twelve lines in a Fulda manuscript naming Phol, Wodan, Sinthgunt, Sunna, Frija and Volla. After this batch the key holds 34 records: 22 female, 11 male, 1 unknown. THE ALTARS DO NOT STOP AT EIGHT EITHER. Also attested, each on its own stone or tablet and none in the registry: HLUDANA, five inscriptions from the Rhineland and Frisia dated 197-235 CE; HARIASA, Cologne 187 CE, the stone now lost and surviving in transcription; VAGDAVERCUSTIS, Cologne, second century; SANDRAUDIGA, North Brabant, second century; VIHANSA, a bronze tablet near Tongeren; and HARIMELLA, an inscription at Birrens in Dumfriesshire - a Germanic goddess attested in Scotland, which is what the Roman army does to a religious map. HLUDANA IS ATTESTED FIVE TIMES AND WAS NOT IN A CORPUS THAT HELD BEDA AND FIMMILENA, attested at one site each. That is not a judgement about importance; it is what happens when a corpus grows by whichever name a particular source happened to put in front of it. And MARS THINGSUS, a god of the ASSEMBLY under the Roman name for a god of war, stands on the Housesteads stones BESIDE FOUR OF THE GODDESSES THE CORPUS ALREADY HELD: it held the four and not him. A VOCABULARY EXTENSION, MADE DELIBERATELY AND DOCUMENTED. The Continental Germanic era vocabulary registered EXACTLY ONE ERA, 'Continental Germanic religion under Rome (1st c. BCE - 3rd c. CE)', and that bucket cannot honestly hold this material: the Merseburg charms are 9th or 10th century, the Old Saxon Baptismal Vow is 9th, the Origo gentis Langobardorum is 7th, and Tacitus's origin songs are about a time before any of it. FILING THEM UNDER A LABEL THAT ENDS IN THE THIRD CENTURY WOULD PUT A DATE ON EACH RECORD THAT THE RECORD'S OWN SOURCES CONTRADICT. So this batch adds two era keys to ERA_ORDER and ERA_DATES in app/data.js, which is the maintenance path that file's own integration-points comment documents - 'When adding a new era key: update ERA_ORDER[tradition] and ERA_DATES[tradition][era]': continental-germanic-mythic-origins, textual -50 to 100, and continental-germanic-migration-and-conversion (4th-10th c.), textual 350 to 1000. THE EXISTING ERA KEY IS UNCHANGED, IN THE SAME POSITION, WITH THE SAME DATES, AND NOTHING ALREADY FILED MOVES; the resulting distribution is 3 / 20 / 11. THIS IS THE FIRST TIME THIS PROGRAMME HAS CHANGED A TRADITION'S ERA VOCABULARY rather than working around it, and it is recorded at length because a vocabulary change is a claim about a tradition's shape and should be arguable, not silent. GODAN AND FREA ARE NOT NEW RECORDS, AND THAT IS THE POINT. The Origo gentis Langobardorum is the textual source of the Lombard theonym Godan and names Frea beside him: Gambara asks Frea for help, Frea tells the Winnili women to tie their hair across their faces and stand where Godan will see them at dawn, Godan asks who the long-beards are, and A PEOPLE'S NAME IS FIXED BY A JOKE AT THE GOD'S EXPENSE. Godan is Wodan and Frea is Frija, and they are recorded as ALIASES on the two records this batch creates, with the Lombard episode on those records' lifecycles, and NOT as two further records. Lane 20 found the corpus holding Vainamoinen and Ilmarinen twice each under two keys and said that duplicating a figure in order to record a second attestation makes the registry worse; THIS IS THAT DECISION TAKEN IN ADVANCE, INSIDE ONE TRADITION KEY, WHERE THE TEMPTATION IS STRONGEST, because Godan and Frea look like different names and come from a different century and a different language. WHAT THE INSCRIPTIONS SAY AND WHAT THEY DO NOT. Three records are Germanic gods under Roman names - Hercules Magusanus, Mars Thingsus, Mercurius Cimbrianus - filed as the corpus files its Sogdian and Bactrian cult-forms. THE PAIRING ON THE STONE IS THE FACT: a dedicator wrote a Roman theonym and a Germanic epithet together. WHICH GERMANIC GOD STANDS BEHIND THE ROMAN NAME IS THE DISPUTED PART AND NO RECORD ANSWERS IT: no edge from Mars Thingsus to anglosaxon_tiw or norse_tyr though the equation is standard, and no edge from Mercurius Cimbrianus to the Wodan ingested in this same batch, though Tacitus says the Germanic peoples worship Mercury above all others and every modern reader takes that to mean Wodan. A REGISTRY CAN HOLD BOTH RECORDS AND LET THE READER MAKE THE EQUATION THE ROMANS MADE; making it in the data would turn a Roman's description of a cult into a statement about a being. The same restraint covers Tacitus's own equation of THE ALCIS with Castor and Pollux, which is on that record as prose. TWO WOMEN WHO ARE IN A REGISTRY OF GODS BECAUSE THE SOURCES PUT THEM THERE. VELEDA, seeress of the Bructeri, predicted the rebels' first successes in the Batavian revolt of 69-70 CE; she lived in a tower and was not spoken to directly, a relative carrying questions in and answers out, and Rome negotiated with her as a power. GANNA of the Semnones SUCCEEDED her at the head of a Germanic alliance and travelled to Rome to be received by Domitian. THE SUCCESSION IS THE FINDING: that one seeress follows another at the head of an alliance means the position was an OFFICE and not a personal reputation, and an office is exactly the kind of thing a registry of religion should be able to show - and the corpus held neither holder of it. ALBRUNA is the third, and her record carries its own textual problem on its face: Aurinia is what the manuscripts of Tacitus give, Albruna is what most editors print, and BOTH ARE ON THE RECORD rather than one being chosen silently. CIVILIS IS REJECTED IN THE SAME BATCH and the line is worth stating: what the sources record of Veleda is a religious office and what they record of him is a campaign. PHOL IS INGESTED AND BALDER IS NOT. The Second Merseburg Incantation names Phol in its first line and Balder's foal in its second, and whether that is one figure under two names or two figures in one scene is the charm's central crux; the corpus holds norse_baldr, so creating a Continental Germanic Balder would either duplicate that record or assert an answer. Phol is ingested, Balder is a census row, AND NEITHER DECIDES IT - the handling lane 21 gave the two Hengests and lane 20 gave Turisas. ZERO PRE-EXISTING RECORDS MUTATED. Every symmetric relation is reciprocated in-batch - Frija and Volla sibling, Sunna and Sinthgunt sibling, Ibor and Aio sibling, Wodan and Frija consort-of both ways - and NO EDGE IS WRITTEN TOWARD ANY OF THE EIGHT PRE-EXISTING RECORDS AT ALL, because the sources give none: the Roman-era altars do not relate their goddesses to each other, and inventing edges between them to make the tradition look connected is exactly what this programme does not do. VIRADECDIS AND RICAGAMBEDA ARE BLOCKED ON A TRADITION QUESTION AND NOT AN EVIDENCE ONE: the sources consulted describe them as Celtic OR Germanic without settling which, and THIS REGISTRY FILES BY TRADITION, so an unresolved tradition is a blocker rather than a detail. THE DROWNED ATTENDANTS OF NERTHUS are a rite and a category of person rather than a figure, recorded as a row because the corpus holds Nerthus and cannot state the most-quoted thing about her cult. And BALDER'S FOAL is a blocked row for the same reason five horses and two hounds were rejected in lanes 13 through 19: an animal identified by an owner. REJECTS: the Ingaevones, Herminones and Istvaeones are PEOPLES - Tacitus names Mannus's three sons only through the peoples descended from them, which is the rule that rejected the Kalevanpojat and the Scyldings meeting the case it was made for; the Winnili and the Naharvali are peoples; the Matronae Aufaniae and Vacallinehae and the Alaisiagae group-title are COLLECTIVES; the Irminsul is an OBJECT; and Arminius, Thusnelda, Segestes, Marbod, Civilis, Radagaisus and the historical Lombard kings are HISTORICAL PEOPLE and not figures of the tradition. First Armenian pass. 23 -> 45 records. THE HEADLINE: THE CORPUS HELD HAYK AND NOT BEL. A 68-name check returned 28 hits and 40 absences. The founding act of the Armenian nation as Movses Khorenatsi tells it is a single arrow: Hayk refuses to submit to Bel the tyrant of Babylon, Bel follows him north with an army, Hayk draws a wide bow and shoots him through the breast, and the people take their name - Hay - from the man who fired it. THE CORPUS HELD THE ARCHER AND NOT THE TARGET, eleven traditions running with the same shape. It also held VAHAGN VISHAPAKAGH, 'Vahagn the Dragon-reaper', AND NO DRAGON; Azhdahak is now in the corpus. And it held Hayk without TORGOM his father, the point at which the Armenian genealogy joins the biblical line from Noah through Japheth. THE PANTHEON WAS HELD AT FOUR. The pantheon-era bucket contained Aramazd, Anahit, Astghik and Vahagn and nothing else, and this batch adds eight: MIHR, god of light, heaven and the sun, whose temple is Garni; NANE, goddess of motherhood, war and wisdom, with spear and shield; TIR, god of learning and writing and the interpreter of dreams; BARSAMIN, the weather and sky god; VANATUR, the New Year god of Navasard; SPANDARAMET, god of the underworld; TORK ANGEGH, the giant who flattens the face of a rock and scratches pictures into it with his fingernails; and GROGH, 'the writer', who settles what becomes of a person. VANATUR COSTS THE MOST: one account makes him the supreme god of the pantheon BEFORE ARAMAZD REPLACED HIM, so the corpus held the replacement and not the god it is said to have replaced. MIHR HAS THE LONGEST REACH: his name becomes Armenian Mher, and the corpus already held MHER THE ELDER and MHER THE YOUNGER of the Sasna Tsrer, a thousand years downstream, and did not hold the god they are named after. THREE DECISIONS ABOUT TYPE AND STATUS. (1) AZHDAHAK IS mortal AND NOT numen: the older layer makes him a dragon and Khorenatsi makes him a king of Media, and the record states the dragon layer in its lifecycle and etymology and files the king, because that is what the retrieved evidence supports as a biography. First Korean pass. 13 -> 41 records. THE HEADLINE: NINE REGISTERED ERAS AND SIX OF THEM EMPTY, AND THE CORPUS HELD ONE OF THE FOUR FOUNDATION MYTHS AND NONE OF THE OTHER THREE. THE SAMGUK YUSA EXISTS TO RECORD THE STATE-FOUNDATION MYTHS AND THERE ARE FOUR OF THEM. The registry had GOGURYEO COMPLETE - Haemosu, Habaek, Yuhwa, Jumong, Yuri - AND NOT ONE FIGURE FROM SILLA, GAYA OR BAEKJE. No BAK HYEOKGEOSE, hatched from a heavenly egg, nor ARYEONG, born of a water dragon at the well she is named after - and the sources set the two births against each other as complementary opposites, one out of the sky and one out of the water, A SYMMETRY A REGISTRY CAN ONLY SHOW IF IT HOLDS BOTH HALVES, AND IT HELD NEITHER. No SEOK TALHAE, who comes over the sea, nor KIM ALJI, found as an infant in a golden box hanging in a wood, whose finding gave the wood the name Gyerim and the kingdom one of its names: SILLA HAS THREE ROYAL SURNAMES AND EACH HAS ITS OWN ARRIVAL STORY - Bak out of an egg, Seok out of the sea, Kim out of a golden box - AND THE CORPUS HAD NONE OF THE THREE. No SURO, first of six golden eggs out of a chest that came down from heaven after nine leaders sang and danced, nor HEO HWANG-OK, who came to him by boat from Ayuta at sixteen. No ONJO and no BIRYU, and no SOSENO - WHO IS THE JOIN BETWEEN TWO OF THE FOUR MYTHS, the widow of Holbon whom Jumong married and whose sons took a second kingdom south: the corpus held one foundation myth complete and could not reach the next one along. It also held Jumong without the court he grew up in - no HAE BURU, no GEUMWA the golden frog who sheltered him, no DAESO who drove him out. THE REGISTRY HELD THE RIVER-CROSSING AND NOT THE PURSUIT. THE SHAMANS' OWN ORIGIN STORY WAS NOT IN IT. PRINCESS BARI is the seventh daughter of a king who wanted a son, thrown away at birth, who comes back when her parents are dying and walks to the underworld for the Water of Revival; KOREAN SHAMANS CALL HER MYTH THEIR ORIGIN STORY and the Barigongju bon-puri has been collected nationwide in more than a hundred versions - and the corpus held six figures of the Jeju bon-puri tradition and not her. Nor YEOMRA, who judges the dead - TEN KINGS OF THE UNDERWORLD AND THE CORPUS HOLDS ONE - nor GANGNIM, the mortal sent to arrest the King of Death who came back with him. NOT ONE HOUSEHOLD GOD. The gasin are the part of Korean religion that was practised daily in every home for centuries, by the women of the house, without a temple or a priest, and all eight are new: SEONGJUSIN the ridge-beam and the fortune of the family; JOWANGSIN the hearth; TEOJUSIN the ground the house stands on; MUNSIN the door; SAMSIN HALMONI childbirth and children's health; EOPSIN the storehouse and the family's wealth; CHEUKSIN the outhouse; and SEONANGSIN the village boundary. JOWANGSIN CARRIES THE MOST PRECISELY ATTESTED RITE IN THIS BATCH AND IT IS A CUP OF WATER: a goddess of FIRE embodied in WATER, in a bowl on a clay altar above the stove, renewed every morning from the well by the woman of the house, who knelt in front of it. CHEUKSIN IS INGESTED AND THE RECORD DOES NOT TREAT HER AS A JOKE: a system that gives a god to every part of a house gives one to that part too, and leaving her out because the room is undignified would be a modern reader's edit of a religion. FOUR FIGURES ARE HELD TWICE - THE SECOND INSTANCE OF LANE 20'S FINDING. korean_cheonjiwang and jeju_cheonjiwang; korean_daebyeolwang and jeju_daebyeolwang; korean_sobyeolwang and jeju_sobyeolwang; korean_jacheongbi and jeju_jacheongbi. Lane 20 found exactly this between the Finnish and Karelian keys, where Vainamoinen and Ilmarinen are each held twice; THIS IS THE SAME FAULT IN A DIFFERENT PART OF THE CORPUS - Jeju shamanism is a regional tradition inside Korean religion, the registry files some of its figures under both keys and some under one, and nothing decides which. THIS BATCH ADDS NOTHING UNDER jeju_ AND CREATES NO NEW DUPLICATES, and YEONGDEUNG HALMANG - the wind-and-sea goddess who comes to Jeju once a year and sows the fish and the shellfish - IS IN NEITHER KEY and is a census row rather than a record for exactly that reason: she belongs beside Seolmundae Halmang under jeju_, and a korean_ copy would make the problem worse. TWO BROTHERS AND ONE THRONE: the histories name the founder of Baekje as ONJO OR BIRYU, both are ingested, and NEITHER RECORD CHOOSES - each names the other and says the sources give both. That is lane 19's two-Myrddins handling and lane 21's two Hengests arrived at from a third direction: there the question was whether two names are one figure, HERE IT IS ONE OFFICE AND TWO CLAIMANTS, and a registry that picked one would be deciding a disagreement between the Samguk Sagi and the Samguk Yusa. TYPE COMPUTED FROM DESCENT, APPLIED BEFORE AUTHORING, THE SIXTH LANE RUNNING: npm test 302/302 on the first run. First Hurrian pass. 14 -> 35 records. THE HEADLINE: THE CORPUS HELD KUMARBI AND NOT ANU. The Kumarbi cycle turns on one act: in the Song of Emergence ALALU is king in heaven, in the ninth year his cup-bearer ANU overthrows him, nine years later Anu's own cup-bearer KUMARBI overthrows him and IN THE STRUGGLE BITES OFF HIS PENIS AND SWALLOWS IT, and Anu curses him - from the seed now inside him five gods will be born who will depose him, and the first is TESHUB. The registry held Alalu, held Kumarbi, held Teshub, AND HELD NO HURRIAN ANU: the god who is bitten, whose curse sets the cycle running, and who fathers the god the cycle is about. THE CORPUS HELD BOTH ENDS OF A SWALLOWING AND NOT THE THING SWALLOWED. It also held ULLIKUMMI and not UPELLURI, the giant on whose shoulder he was set to grow - the being already alive when heaven and earth were separated, who carries them on his back AND DOES NOT NOTICE A MOUNTAIN RISING ON HIM. And it held two of Kumarbi's champions, Ullikummi the stone and Hedammu the sea-serpent, and not SILVER, the one who actually reached the throne and has a song of the cycle to himself. FOUR OF THE SWEEP'S TWENTY-ONE HITS ARE FALSE AND THAT IS PART OF THE FINDING. A 46-name check returned 21 hits and 25 absences before this batch, and the hits flatter the corpus badly: 'Anu' resolves onto mesopotamian_anu AND onto irish_danu, which carries Anu as an alias; 'Ishara' onto eblaite_ishara; 'Adamma' onto eblaite_adamma; 'Kubaba' onto lydian_kuvava; 'Nikkal' onto canaanite_nikkal. EVERY ONE IS A REAL RECORD OF A REAL FIGURE IN ANOTHER TRADITION AND NONE IS THIS TRADITION'S RECORD OF THE SAME CULT. A NAME-SWEEP OVER A CORPUS THAT FILES BY TRADITION WILL ALWAYS REPORT A TRADITION AS BETTER COVERED THAN IT IS wherever that tradition's gods came from somewhere else - and the Hurrian pantheon is explicitly described as one that took gods in from Eblaite and Mesopotamian sources. After this batch: 39 hits, 7 absences, all 21 new records resolving. THE CIRCLE OF HEBAT. The kaluti are offering lists organised around a principal deity that name the circle going with them, so IN THIS MATERIAL A PRINCIPAL DEITY IS DOCUMENTED THROUGH THAT CIRCLE and holding the principal without it is holding half the attestation. The corpus held HEBAT and SHARRUMA and nobody else of hers: not TAKITU her attendant, not ALLANZU and KUNZISHALLI her other children, not SHUWALA, ADAMMA, KUBABA or NABARBI. It held TESHUB and not SHERI and HURRI, the two bulls that pull his wagon, whose names are the words for DAY and NIGHT - nor TILLA, who stands in Hurri's place in the eastern tradition. It held the moon god KUSHUH and not NIKKAL his consort. And it held one of the three goddesses the scholarship calls primary - SHAUSHKA - and neither ALLANI, goddess of the underworld and one of the determiners of mortal fates, nor ISHARA, invoked beside her to keep demons out of a household. THE SECOND SWEEP CAUGHT A DUPLICATE AND THE BATCH DROPPED A RECORD. An hurrian_umbu record was authored and then removed: the sources place Nikkal in the kaluti 'after Ishara and before the pair Umbu-Nikkal' and Umbu looked like a separate deity, but THE POST-GENERATION SWEEP RESOLVED 'UMBU' ONTO hurrian_kushuh, WHICH ALREADY CARRIES IT AS AN ALIAS. A second record would have been the within-tradition duplicate this programme forbids, so the record was deleted and Nikkal's pairing edge rewritten to point at Kushuh where the name already lives. THIS IS THE CLEAREST THING THE TWICE-RUN SWEEP HAS CAUGHT IN ELEVEN LANES: until now the second sweep's value was better BLOCKED rows, and here it stopped a duplicate from shipping. A BUILD-HYGIENE FINDING, REPORTED BECAUSE IT COST A TEST RUN: deleting that record made npm test fail, not on the data but on test/static.test.cjs - 'figure pages (6608) vs corpus figures (6607)'. SCRIPTS/BUILD-STATIC.CJS DOES NOT PRUNE STATIC PAGES FOR FIGURES THAT HAVE BEEN REMOVED; dist/site/registry/hurrian_umbu.html survived the rebuild and the per-figure page count no longer matched. Removing the stale file by hand restored 302/302. This cannot bite CI, which builds from a clean checkout into an empty dist/, and dist/site is gitignored, so it is a working-tree-only hazard that only appears when a record is DELETED between builds, which almost never happens in an append-only corpus. IT IS REPORTED RATHER THAN FIXED, because a pruning step in the static builder is a change to the build and the owner should decide whether the builder should clean its output directory. TWO DECISIONS ABOUT HOW THE CORPUS FILES ADOPTED GODS. The Hurrian pantheon took gods in from elsewhere and the corpus already holds four of them under the keys they came from: Ishara and Adamma of Eblaite background, held as eblaite_ishara and eblaite_adamma; Kubaba the goddess of Carchemish, whom the sweep resolves onto lydian_kuvava; and Nikkal, from Mesopotamian Ningal by way of Ugaritic, held as canaanite_nikkal. This batch creates Hurrian records beside them AND DRAWS NO EDGES. THIS IS THE GREEK/ROMAN PATTERN AND NOT THE FINNISH/KARELIAN ONE: lane 20 criticised holding Vainamoinen twice because Finnish and Karelian are the same body of material under two keys, and Eblaite, Lydian, Canaanite and Hurrian are different peoples, languages and millennia, each with its own attestation of the cult. AND THE ANATOLIAN KEYS HAVE THE FINNISH/KARELIAN PROBLEM ANYWAY, which this batch met and did not touch: the corpus holds hittite_telipinu AND hattic_telipinu, two records for one god across two keys of the same Anatolian religious world - lane 20's finding and lane 24's, in a third part of the corpus, recorded as a census row. TWO PAIRS, TWO DECISIONS, OPPOSITE WAYS. HUTENA AND HUTELLURA ARE ONE RECORD, because the offering lists write them as a hyphenated unit and give neither a separate act, and splitting them would invent two designations the evidence does not have - the ground lane 22 gave the Alcis. HURRI AND TILLA ARE TWO RECORDS, because the sources say Hurri's NAME is replaced by Tilla in the eastern tradition, which is a statement about two regional traditions and not about one being with two names; neither record says they are the same and neither says they are not. ZERO PRE-EXISTING RECORDS MUTATED: every symmetric relation reciprocated in-batch, and fourteen edges point at pre-existing records and all are non-symmetric. ALLANZU AND KUNZISHALLI CARRY child-of HEBAT AS A RELATION AND NOT AS parentIds, for lane 23's reason: an offering list's ORDERING is not a genealogy, and in this corpus parentIds drives the computed tier. ANU'S father-of TESHUB IS THE STRANGEST EDGE IN THE CORPUS - the father is bitten, the seed is swallowed, and the mother is the man who swallowed it - and it is written from Anu's end only, because Teshub is pre-existing. WHAT IS NOT ASSERTED: no edge from Anu to mesopotamian_anu, because the Hurrian succession myth taking the Mesopotamian sky god's name is a fact about how the myth was built; no edge from Upelluri to any Atlas-figure, because the comparison is a scholar's; nothing about Kubaba and Kybele, a proposal and not a source; ULLIKUMMI'S MOTHER IS NOT DECIDED, because the sources give the sea god's daughter Sertapsuruhi, whom the corpus holds, OR a female cliff, and the record notes both and chooses neither; and THE FIVE GODS OF ANU'S CURSE ARE NOT MANUFACTURED, because the sources name a number and name Teshub as the first. 5 REJECT: the IRSIRRA, the nursery goddesses who carry the infant Ullikummi to Upelluri's shoulder, which the sources CALL A COLLECTIVE IN AS MANY WORDS; the kaluti themselves, which are texts; the Dark Earth, a place; the boulder Ullikummi was engendered on, an object; and the five songs of the cycle, texts. 12 BLOCKED. KIASHE THE SEA GOD IS THE SHARPEST: Kumarbi's ally, WHOSE DAUGHTER SERTAPSURUHI THE CORPUS ALREADY HOLDS - the registry has the daughter and not the father, this programme's recurring fault at one remove. LAMMA IS THE STRANGEST: one of the five songs of the cycle is the Song of LAMMA, and LAMMA is a LOGOGRAM standing for a tutelary god whose Hurrian or Hittite name is not settled. Lane 22 met the reverse case in Mars Thingsus, where a Roman name carried a Germanic epithet that gave something to hold the god by; HERE THERE IS NO EPITHET AND NO NAME, ONLY A SIGN. TWO NEW VERIFIED-SOLITARY VERDICTS: Ashtabi and the Goddess of the Night. npm test 302/302. PARTIAL. What remains: Kiashe the Sea God, whose daughter is already held; Impaluri and Shalash; the Hurrian primeval deities, which need the per-name sourcing lane 17 gave the Navagraha; LAMMA, who needs a name before he can have a record; and the ANATOLIAN TRADITION-KEY QUESTION - Telipinu held twice, Shuwaliyatti beside the Hittite Suwaliyat, and a Hittite Anu that may or may not need to exist. First Buddhist pass. 14 -> 48 records. THE HEADLINE: THE REGISTRY HELD MARA AND HIS THREE DAUGHTERS AND NOT THE MAN THEY WERE SENT TO TEMPT. The Buddhist key held fourteen records and every one of them was a deva or an adversary - Mara, his daughters Tanha, Arati and Raga, Sakra, Sakra's wife Suja, the asura lord Vemacitrin, Brahma Sahampati, Prthivi, Yama, and the Four Heavenly Kings - figures Buddhism inherited from the Indian pantheon and filed into its cosmology.
